messages:
mike (AE): Heads-up  Prospect (NovaMed) wants to sign a POC orderform today. They attached a PO from a local subsidiary, a vendor security questionnaire and asked for a KMS/HSM attestation. Also asked that the order form reflect milestone billing (POC fee + activation). Who needs to review before we send esign? Need this live by EOD.

tara (sales-ops): Order form uploaded: https://drive.internal/po/novamed-poc. Amounts: $11,500 POC + $3,850 activation. Template candidate: "OrderForm-PO-Milestones-v2". I can attach PO + questionnaire.

leo (finance): For $11.5k this is within sales-manager approval. Finance still needs billing contact, vendor tax ID, and PO number before invoicing. AP prefers the PO attached to the envelope and a custom field PO_NUMBER so matching is automatic. Net30 default; Net45 requires director approval.

anya (legal): Any redlines to MSA/DPA in the attachments? If the questionnaire or PO introduces new residency or indemnity language, we need to review before signature. Otherwise legal can be set as post-sign reviewer. For KMS attestation we can provide a short addendum; if they request warranty language or specific vendor certificates, route to infra (24-48h).

mike (AE): They did not attach MSA redlines, but the PO is issued by a Bulgarian subsidiary and they asked that the orderform include a sentence: "Cryptographic keys for EU customer data will be stored in EU HSM-backed key stores." Can legal sign that?

infra-bot: Suggested non-warranty attestation language: "Redwood will store cryptographic keys used to protect Customer EU data in EU-based, HSM-backed key stores upon Customer's written request." For vendor/HSM certificates we need infra confirmation; expect 24-48h if they insist on proof. SOC2 link: https://security.redwood/soc2.

esign-bot: Template matched: "OrderForm-PO-Milestones-v2". API override example: {"templateId":"OF-PO-v2","signerOrder":["ae","sales_mgr","finance","customer_exec"]}. DocuSign link: https://docusign.internal/templates/OF-PO-v2. You can attach multiple docs in one envelope.

tara (sales-ops): Proposed signer order: AE placeholder -> Sales Manager -> Finance(billing) -> Customer CFO -> Customer PO issuer. Legal set as reviewer post-sign. I'll set envelope custom fields: PO_NUMBER and BILLING_ENTITY. Attachments: PO, vendor questionnaire, KMS addendum.

leo (finance): That works. Finance requires the PO number in the envelope metadata and the billing entity field set to the PO issuer so AP can invoice correctly. Also request invoice line items for each milestone so our accounting system can auto-match.

anya (legal): We will not countersign the orderform for a standard addendum. I will draft a short KMS addendum today and upload it. If customer insists on "warrants" or SLA changes in the PO/MSA, hold the envelope and escalate to legal+infra.

mike (AE): Buyer said they'll accept our addendum language for now and will not insist on legal signature. They want everything signed in one envelope. ETA for PO = 2 hours.

tara (sales-ops): I'll prepare the envelope once PO and billing contact arrive. Plan: use template OF-PO-v2, override sign order as above, attach documents, set PO_NUMBER custom field = customer-provided PO.

leo (finance): If the PO requests Net45, flag for director approval. Otherwise proceed. Also note: for multi-entity flows, ensure invoice made out to PO-issuing entity.

anya (legal): Draft uploaded: https://legal.internal/drafts/kms-addendum-novamed-v1.docx. Minimal attestation: confirms HSM-backed key storage in EU region upon customer request. No warranty language.

mike (AE): PO just uploaded. Tara - please send envelope and cc accounting. I'll monitor signature.

tara (sales-ops): Sending envelope now. Signer order set, attachments included, PO_NUMBER and BILLING_ENTITY fields populated. Legal has been set as post-sign reviewer. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: FYI: If the customer later asks for key rotation frequency or FIPS/HSM vendor specifics, we must involve SRE. Provide non-sensitive summaries in the addendum only.

leo (finance): AP received PO copy and will reconcile after signature. Net30 confirmed.

anya (legal): I'll watch for any post-sign redlines in the questionnaire or DPA. If they send redlines on residency or indemnity, pause and escalate.

mike (AE): Thanks team. I'll kick off the POC once signatures clear. Closing thread when fully executed. :rocket:
